nativeContract.zeroBranch: Clears frozen, evaluates WDAT at the native clock, updates cloud/rain/snow/auxiliary channels, then caches year/month/day/hour/minute.
nativeContract.nonzeroBranch: Writes frozen=1; does not sample the clock or clear existing channels.
nativeContract.curveWord: Intensity in bits 24-31; packed date in bits 0-23. Interpolation uses the packed integer, not elapsed wall-clock minutes.

precipitation.behavior: Replaces the first exclusion volume of existing kind-one fields. Four float32 X/Z points retain authored winding; Y is inclusive and all four signed cross-products must be strictly negative. Existing rain/snow/splash components receive lower-padding and upper+padding. Empty lists and absent components are native no-ops, not pending configuration for future owners.

evidenceBoundary: Source-backed calendar/curve lookup is separate from browser weather rendering and story-clock authority.
WAIR state, time-table sampling and initial sky selection are separate from native solar rotation, fog-table application, particles and sprite transition timing.
The browser sky dome uses the selected resource's primary image; the second cloud/rain strip and original sprite projection are not reproduced.
Forecast pointer construction and explicit weather override modes 9-13 are not recovered by this catalog.
Cloud/rain/snow curve reads alone do not prove the entire 0x0176 refresh helper is implemented.
